cut_week.title: Be ready for the Release Cut...
cut_week.description: Prepare your work, and have all possible reviews before going to Staging on Wednesday.
checklist: 🔍 Request reviews on everything you have open
🧪 Get CI green early, not on Wednesday morning
🔗 Link each PR to its ADO ticket

deploy_week.title: Verify your work on Staging
deploy_week.description: The release branch is already cut. Production goes out Thursday.
checklist: 🧪 Test your changes on Staging today
🐞 Raise any regression you find straight away
🚫 New work merges to develop, not the release branch

cut_week.title: The Release Cut is tomorrow...
cut_week.description: It’s time to check if your work is really ready for Staging.
checklist: ✅ Land your final reviews today
🧹 Resolve every outstanding comment
🚦 Confirm your work is genuinely Staging-ready

deploy_week.title: Deployment is on Thursday
deploy_week.description: Anything not verified on Staging by Wednesday night ships as-is.
checklist: 🔎 Finish your Staging verification
🐞 Report blockers now, not on Thursday
📋 Check your ADO items reflect reality

cut_week.title: Release Cut Day!
cut_week.description: The release cut will be made around 8pm PST.
checklist: 🛑 Merge before 8pm PST, or wait for the next cut
👀 Watch for the release branch to appear
🧯 Raise blockers in this channel before the cut

deploy_week.title: Final checks before deployment
deploy_week.description: Last full day to catch anything before production.
checklist: ✅ Sign off your changes on Staging
🧯 Flag anything that should block the deploy
📣 Speak up now — tomorrow is too late

cut_week.title: The cut is in — verify on Staging
cut_week.description: The release branch exists. Production deployment follows next Thursday.
checklist: 🔬 Verify your changes on Staging
🩹 Fixes go to the release branch, not develop
📅 Deployment is next Thursday around 9pm PST

deploy_week.title: DEPLOYMENT DAY!
deploy_week.description: The production deployment will be made around 9pm PST.
checklist: 📋 Verify your changes on Staging before tonight
🆘 Stay reachable during the deploy window
🔎 Sanity-check production once it is live

footer: Release cut every other Wednesday · Deployment the Thursday of the following week

release_cycle._verified: Deploy offset confirmed against 14 consecutive successful builds of research-platform-ui/research-platform-ui-prd-pipeline on Jenkins, all Thursday, all cut+8d, 21:00-22:00 Pacific.
